goals.name: 切换工作区侧面板或内容区域
behavior: With unifiedTabStrip, CZe dispatches run-command toggleSidePanel; otherwise it sends toggle-diff-panel to a live M window.

Workspace J registers C(toggleSidePanel,M,{enabled:unified,isActive:workspaceExists,menuItem:dynamic}). Its full branch preserves persistent/content guards: focus previous content via W(...,{restoreFocus:true}) when Q, otherwise re plus optional empty-tab discard, then guarded animation-frame composer focus.
The non-full J branch delegates D inside H(layout_command); H/$H scope restoration is reused from the prior source contract.

Legacy renderer BPt subscribes to toggle-diff-panel and delegates its injected callback with message.open (absent from native menu payload). Nw command fallback independently requests windows.review.toggle; these routes are not proven equivalent.
conditions: unifiedTabStrip, actual registration priority/mount, workspace presence, full/split state and tab/persistent guards.
failureAndCancellation: Full branch can return at its guard; no window means no native message. Delegate state changes, focus and errors remain unobserved.
knownGaps: Effective command winner, D/W/re and legacy callback provider, real focus/visibility and durability.
deduplication: FSC-0405 cycles workspace layout through stepWorkspaceLayout. This separate command changes selected content/visibility with different full-mode guards; retain one contextual goal across labels.

goals.name: 在当前内容中查找及跳转匹配项
behavior: Native open/next/previous first await oZ(action). oZ reads focused webContents and aZ entry, then returns its run(action) result. A truthy result stops dispatch; rejection propagates at this selected callback boundary.

If not handled, Ve tries runFocusedVisiblePageCommand with open-find/find-next/find-previous, first with valid focused window or otherwise eligible windows. Only after both earlier routes are false does M receive find-in-thread/find-next-in-thread/find-previous-in-thread.

Renderer JNt selects contextual conversation/diff/browser/page find domain and selection. Browser queries/next/previous delegate browserController.runCommand; other domains use selected scope helpers. Open may wait an animation frame for page/native selection conditions.

Page Lt independently subscribes to the same three messages; open delegates open-find, while next/previous require isFindOpen. Ws and L explicitly import Pvn from app-shared, resolving the previously saved hre subscription hook.

Fsc switch labels for these messages are no-ops in that dispatcher, not the actual feature receiver. HQs excludes findInThread from its ordinary generated Electron shortcut list, consistent with native special handling.
conditions: Focused content handler truthiness, browser manager return, mounted JNt/Lt, selected find domain and open state.
failureAndCancellation: Do not broadcast a fallback when an earlier route handles the action. Missing M returns; rejected oZ is not a false result. Actual search indexing, matches/order and browser/DOM delivery remain delegated.
knownGaps: aZ registration/provider and mounted subscriber ownership, actual domain search/match ordering, find state/focus, native command and service errors.
deduplication: Open/next/previous are three operations of one contextual find goal. FSC-0392 searches files; FSC-0393 global search palette is separate.

goals.name: 导航到当前列表中的前一线程
behavior: CZe primary and hidden alternate previousThread accelerators both use _e(previousThread,{allowAppShellTabShortcut:qe(...)}). Flag requires actual accelerator trigger plus matching default mapped previousTab accelerator; ordinary click does not automatically set it. Thread-navigation shortcut lock can suppress the flag.

JQa registers Pw(previousThread,handler,{contextHandler,isActive,priority,keyboardHandler}). It first attempts previousTab through Mw only under KQa/context/key conditions; otherwise uses current getTargets() result or provided targets.

With current target, select index-1; with no current target, select last. Empty list, unknown current target/index and out-of-range predecessor return without onSelect. There is no unconditional wrap at the first target.

Selection can invoke shortcut-preference tracking when event/allow context matches both tab/thread keymaps. Target list/order and onSelect are injected; actual routing and chronological history semantics are not established.
conditions: Mounted registration and caller target order/current selection, isActive/priority, keymaps, native accelerator metadata and navigation lock.
failureAndCancellation: No target or no predecessor produces no onSelect. Tab shortcut interception may handle first; delegate failures and persistence remain unknown.
knownGaps: Caller getTargets/getCurrentTarget/onSelect, actual command winner, tab versus thread route effect and stored shortcut preferences.
deduplication: FSC-0394 selects numbered sidebar entries. previousRecentThread uses another command; neither establishes equivalence to previousThread.
